description: Look up one vulnerability or malicious-package advisory by ID (CVE, GHSA, PYSEC, GO, RUSTSEC, MAL and other OSV IDs) and return its summary, severity, CVSS vector, aliases, publish date, the affected packages with their affected and fixed version ranges, and key references. Use when the user mentions a specific advisory or CVE ID ("what is CVE-2021-44228?", "am I affected by this GHSA?") and wants to know what it is, what is affected or which version fixes it. Only covers advisories in OSV.dev.

id.description: Advisory ID, e.g. CVE-2021-44228, GHSA-29mw-wpgm-hmr9, PYSEC-2018-28, MAL-2025-20690

name: get_vulnerability
title: Get vulnerability details
